brain.commentary: The cross-asset regime is risk-on, but conviction is generally modest and crypto volatility is elevated. Maintain a defensive neutral posture: favor BTC, LINK, and selectively LTC, while capping exposure to high-volatility or illiquid alts. Fragile signals include XRP, DOGE, ADA, BCH, ETC, XLM, and AVAX due to weak alpha, institutional scores, liquidity, or flat council directions. UNI has the strongest raw signal but remains fragile on implementation risk because of 73% volatility and poor liquidity; do not treat its high conviction as a license for outsized exposure.
